'''J. Kegler my ewok deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[J. Kegler]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9415">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9415 my ewok deck], DeckTech (J. "Jedi2000" Kegler, 13 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9415/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9415/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018134905/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9415/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''my ewok deck'''
* '''Author:''' J. "Jedi2000" Kegler
* '''Published:''' August 13, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' use ewoks to force drain heavy and sue some mains for beat down

=== Strategy ===

drop down dos and chewie or chief chirpa t rebel landing site. get the non-uniques and hope to get kazak and then get out all your location sna drain away. have omse ati-endo rops. deck counters cuz they might like to fight on endor w/ combat vehicles. have jeid luke and obi-wan for main protection
